caseName: United States v. Edward P. Stahel & Co.
caseNameFull: United States v. EDWARD P. STAHEL & CO., INC.

opinions.text:
Eminent domain; requisition of silk; ceiling price as just compensation. Judgments for plaintiffs. Plaintiffs’ and defendant’s motions for new trial overruled.

Defendant’s petition for writs of certiorari denied by the Supreme Court
